Title: Customers list shows its columns, links and status filter options
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/CustomerList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Customers and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the column headings of the table.
Step Expected: The columns QAL Number, Name, Organisation, Details, Participants and Contracts are shown.

Step Action: Read the links above the table.
Step Expected: The links Create Customer, Review Pending Customer Updates, Review Pending Participant Updates and Review Pending Orders are shown. Do not click them.

Step Action: Open the status dropdown.
Step Expected: The options Active Only, Inactive Only and All are listed.

Step Action: Look for the Filter button.
Step Expected: The Filter button is visible.

Title: Filtering the Customers list by Inactive Only and All keeps the page
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/CustomerList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Customers and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Select Inactive Only in the status dropdown and click Filter.
Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Customers and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the column headings of the table.
Step Expected: The columns QAL Number, Name, Organisation, Details, Participants and Contracts are still shown.

Step Action: Select All in the status dropdown and click Filter.
Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Customers and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Look at the table.
Step Expected: At least one customer row is shown.

Title: Review Pending Customer Updates link opens its page from Customers
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/CustomerList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Customers and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Look for the Review Pending Customer Updates link.
Step Expected: The link is visible.

Step Action: Click the Review Pending Customer Updates link.
Step Expected: The browser opens the review page.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Customer Updates.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown and the h1 is still Review Pending Customer Updates.
